Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MA.
We generated $17.8 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Revenue guidance of $4.4 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2023.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $7.20 per share.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
Thank you for the question. Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 904 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
